zh: a conflict (1802-15) in which the French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte tried to gain control of the whole of Europe. In 1812 Napoleon lost half a million men when he invaded Russia in winter, and in 1814 the British, Russians, Prussians and Austrians entered Paris. They sent Napoleon to rule the island of Elba in the Mediterranean, but he collected an army around him and returned to Paris. He was soon defeated again, at the Battle of Waterloo (1815), and was sent to the island of St Helena in the south Atlantic, where he died in 1821.

zh: a big museum in London, with displays about plants, animals, insects, fossils (= animals and plants preserved in rock) and minerals. The museum's collections are so large that the discovery of previously unknown insects in the collections is not uncommon. It was originally part of the British Museum but has been independently run since 1963.
